channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Dereck Lively | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Dereck Lively from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Xavier Tillman on Dereck Lively
item.description:
Tillman explained his favorite part of the moment.

“I made it and I looked right at the bench because I think Dereck Lively was right behind me when I shot it and he was like, ‘(expletive) no,’”

Xavier Tillman on Dereck Lively, Aug 15, 2024. Source: Booth Newspapers.

item.title: Luka Doncic on Dereck Lively
item.description:
Michael Scotto:Luka Doncic on Dereck Lively:

“He’s been amazing this season and playoffs. He took not one, not two, three steps forward. He’s a rookie. I think people still forget this sometimes. He’s doing this in the Western Conference Finals, which is insane. His ceiling is gonna be huge.”

Luka Doncic on Dereck Lively, May 25, 2024. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Luka Doncic on Dereck Lively
item.description:
Luka Doncic:

“Yeah, I told D-Live [Dereck Lively II] to set a screen because they're gonna switch, we wanted that.”

Luka Doncic on Dereck Lively, May 25, 2024. Source: Twitter @ClutchPointsApp.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Dereck Lively
item.description:
Clemente Almanza:Mark Daigneault on Hack-a-Lively:

“We like doing it when there's a number advantage of doing it.”

Mark Daigneault on Dereck Lively, May 11, 2024. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Dereck Lively
item.description:
Mike Curtis:Jason Kidd on Dereck Lively being in attendance tonight:

“For his mom to pass this afternoon, for him to come to work, he had every right to stay with his family and friends... It just shows leadership. We're going to be here to support him.”

Jason Kidd on Dereck Lively, Apr 12, 2024. Source: Twitter @MikeACurtis2.

item.title: Olivier-Maxence Prosper on Dereck Lively
item.description:
Prosper on Lively:

“He's going to be a significant, significant part of this team this year. I'm excited to see him on the court.”

Olivier-Maxence Prosper on Dereck Lively, Sep 29, 2023. Source: Twitter @townbrad.
